mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound (account_id, requested_qty, current_holding_at_request, approved_qty) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{requestedQty}, #{currentHoldingAtRequest}, #{approvedQty})

INSERT INTO inbound_detail (inbound_id, foreign_product_id, source_broker, qty, current_qty, purchase_date, purchase_price, purchase_currency, purchase_fx_rate, source_general_account_id) VALUES (#{inboundId}, #{foreignProductId}, #{sourceBroker}, #{qty}, #{currentQty}, #{purchaseDate}, #{purchasePrice}, #{purchaseCurrency}, #{purchaseFxRate}, #{sourceGeneralAccountId})
INSERT INTO inbound_min (inbound_detail_id, requested_qty, approved_qty, snapshot_qty) VALUES (#{inboundDetailId}, #{requestedQty}, #{approvedQty}, #{snapshotQty})
